requirements.RC-1222: Calculation cache is an optional derivative optimization behind a cache-store contract.
requirements.RC-1223: Repeated natal reads reuse a valid cached result instead of recalculating every screen open.
requirements.RC-1224: Cache identity includes canonical calculation input fingerprint and engineVersion, with subject identity and calculation kind preventing collisions.
requirements.RC-1225: Changing engineVersion changes cache identity and forces recomputation.
requirements.RC-1226: Subject identity is part of the key so another client's cached calculation cannot be returned.
requirements.RC-1227: Cache is derivative only; authoritative source/calculation callback remains required for rebuild.
requirements.RC-1228: Deleting a cache entry causes deterministic recomputation rather than data loss.
requirements.RC-1229: Daily cache reuse is bounded by explicit local-day identity.
requirements.RC-1230: Planetary-hour cache reuse is bounded by explicit planetary-hour window identity.
requirements.RC-1231: Today data becomes stale when local-day identity changes after midnight.
requirements.RC-1232: Daily/current cache is reevaluated when the calculation timezone changes.
requirements.RC-1233: Natal cache validity depends on natal identity, not the user's current travel location/timezone.
requirements.RC-1234: Transit current-location identity is separate from natal birthplace identity.
requirements.RC-1235: Solar Return cache context requires an explicit technique location.
requirements.RC-1236: Non-default user calculation settings can be preserved as explicit Calculation Manifest overrides.

release_blockers: Production persistent cache adapter is not yet wired to SQLite.
Real timezone/DST boundary integration tests remain required.
Production calculation services must adopt this coordinator before VERIFIED/DONE.
